title: By Council Member Thomas-Henry: Pursuant to Rule 11.20(b) of the Council Rules and Section 19-160.2 of the New York City Administrative Code, the Council resolves that the action of the Department of Transportation approving a sidewalk café located at 45-18 104th Street, Corona, NY 11368, Borough of Queens, Council District 21, Community District 4, related to Application No. D 2550162086 SWQ (Cali Tajadas Bakery & Restaurant) shall be subject to review by the Council.
